text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One afternoon, I spotted horse girls of the Mejiro family walking through the courtyard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: They were probably on their way to a tea party.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The entire Mejiro family gathered together... What an elegant sight—
choice_data_list: (Wait, there's someone who isn't a Mejiro?!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: That theory on running forms from that country you mentioned this morning... I wanted to hear it through to the end.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Come now, won't you tell me? Don't hold back, will you?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To outside eyes, she almost seemed overwhelmed by Mejiro Ramonu's assertive tone...
And afterwards—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Weaving through the pack as thick as a storm of blades and bullets, she burst forth beyond the green horizon!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"The moment she spoke! Behind her—
...Behind her was—..."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Oh? What is the matter? It is Pocket-san's turn, is it not? Come, if you please!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Gaaah! Don't drag me into this in the first place! If you wanna do it so bad—

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Oh!! Oi, you over there! You're free, right? You look completely free!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...I have 12 minutes—until my next scheduled item.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text: Then you're totally free! Cover for me, please! I'll pay ya back for this!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "The final clash! Heart roaring furiously, breaking away with the swiftness of Hermes!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "Eek." "Opera O-sama, how wonderful." ..."Just like the sun~"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even after that, I kept spotting Symboli Kris S getting roped into things all over the academy—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Individual name: Mambo. Bird of prey.
If indoors—where would it hide...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...It seems that today, once again, she has gotten dragged into something.
choice_data_list: You've seemed pretty busy lately, are you holding up all right?
You've seemed pretty busy lately, are you holding up all right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taciturn as she is, I worried she might just be unable to say no and was suffering in silence.
Or so I thought, but—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —No problem.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Accidents happen.
............The unexpected is also within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—An unexpected lunch. An unexpected rule violation.
An unexpected stage appearance. An unexpected prank...
choice_data_list: (Seems like it's nothing BUT unexpected events...)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Even so—no problem.
Things are fine as they are............ No—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —It must be this way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If she says so herself, there's probably no point in worrying any further—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey, did C.B. come through here?!
The teacher called for her, but I can't find her anywhere...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—She has not passed by. However—over there,
I saw a silhouette—of similar stature.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What?! Where?!
Can you show me the way?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...And thus, Symboli Kris S was roped into yet another situation.
